description: This file defines a class for configuring and managing Fireworks AI embedding models, including support for OpenAI compatibility and model identification helper methods.

classes.name: FireworksAIEmbeddingConfig
classes.description: A configuration class for handling Fireworks AI embedding models, supporting parameter mapping and model identification.

methods.name: get_supported_openai_params(self, model: str)
methods.description: Returns a list of OpenAI-compatible parameters supported by the specified model, specifically 'dimensions' for models from 'nomic-ai'.

methods.name: map_openai_params( self, non_default_params: dict, optional_params: dict, model: str )
methods.description: Maps non-default parameters to optional parameters if they are supported by the model, ensuring OpenAI compatibility.

methods.name: is_fireworks_embedding_model(self, model: str)
methods.description: Checks if a given model name corresponds to a known Fireworks AI embedding model.

ctags.name: map_openai_params
ctags.signature: ( self, non_default_params: dict, optional_params: dict, model: str )
